# Corner Site Co.

> Website design for small businesses across Canada, based in Ottawa, Ontario.
> We build a free draft of your homepage first. You pay only after you've
> seen the finished site and approved it.

## What we do
- Websites for small businesses: auto repair, barbers and salons,
  restaurants and cafés, trades and contractors, retail and more
- A free homepage draft before any payment
- Google Business Profile fix-up and ongoing care

## Prices (CAD)
- Pay once: $490, plus your web address (about $20/year). Hosting included,
  no monthly fees. Small fixes free for 30 days, later changes $49 each.
- Pay monthly: $20/month with nothing upfront, plus your web address.
  Hosting, email at your web address, a simple logo and small changes included. Cancel any time.
- Google Profile Care: a $225 one-time fix-up of your Google Business Profile.

## How it works
- Up to 2 rounds of changes before launch
- Usually live 3 business days after you approve, always within 7
- You own your domain and files

## Where we work
Based in Ottawa. We work with small businesses across Canada.
